    <style>
    :root{
    /* ── Forest & earth palette ── */
    /* Backgrounds */
    --bg:#f7f5ef; /* warm cream — like aged paper, easier on eyes than white */
    --surf:#ffffff; /* card surface, slightly elevated */
    --surf-2:#f0ede4; /* subtle inset, for nested panels */
    --border:rgba(56,52,42,.10);
    --border-strong:rgba(56,52,42,.18);
    /* Text — warm dark brown rather than pure black */
    --txt:#2d2a22;
    --muted:#6b6b62;
    --faint:#a9a89e;
    /* ── Forest greens (primary brand) ── */
    --primary:#3d6b4f; /* sage forest green — main brand */
    --primary-dark:#2a4d39; /* deeper green for headers */
    --primary-soft:#a8c5b3; /* soft sage for backgrounds */
    --primary-tint:rgba(61,107,79,.08);
    /* ── Earth accents ── */
    --earth:#8b6f47; /* warm tan — for highlights */
    --earth-soft:#d9c9a6;
    --moss:#7d8b3a; /* moss yellow-green — secondary accent */
    --clay:#b85d3e; /* warm terracotta — for warnings/alerts */
    /* ── Status colors (muted, natural) ── */
    --green:#3d6b4f; /* matches primary — done */
    --amber:#c98a2b; /* warm honey amber */
    --red:#a8453d; /* muted brick red */
    --blue:#4a7a9e; /* slate blue */
    --gold:#c98a2b; /* same as amber for consistency */
    --teal:#3d6b4f; /* legacy alias → primary */
    /* ── Shadows (softer, less harsh) ── */
    --sh:0 1px 3px rgba(56,52,42,.06),0 2px 8px rgba(56,52,42,.04);
    --sh-md:0 2px 6px rgba(56,52,42,.08),0 6px 16px rgba(56,52,42,.06);
    --sh-lg:0 4px 12px rgba(56,52,42,.10),0 12px 28px rgba(56,52,42,.08);
    --r:14px;
    --r-sm:10px;
    --r-lg:18px;
    }
    *{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
    html{-webkit-text-size-adjust:none;scroll-behavior:smooth}
    /* Chinese-first font stack: PingFang on Apple, Noto/PingFang fallback elsewhere */
    body{font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"PingFang TC","PingFang HK","PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Microsoft JhengHei","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans CJK TC","Noto Sans TC",-apple-system,sans-serif;
    background:var(--bg);color:var(--txt);font-size:15.5px;line-height:1.65;
    min-height:100dvh;
    -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;-moz-osx-font-smoothing:grayscale;
    /* Slightly looser letter spacing helps Chinese readability */
    letter-spacing:.01em;
    /* Subtle paper grain texture via gradient — softens the eye */
    background-image:radial-gradient(ellipse at top right,rgba(168,197,179,.08),transparent 60%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse at bottom left,rgba(217,201,166,.06),transparent 60%);
    background-attachment:fixed}
    /* Responsive: slightly smaller on tiny screens to avoid overflow,
    but never below 14.5px which is the minimum for comfortable Chinese reading */
    @media (max-width:340px){body{font-size:14.5px}}
    /* Larger phones (most modern devices) get full size */
    @media (min-width:380px){body{font-size:16px}}
    /* ── TOP — natural forest gradient instead of dark teal ── */
    .top{background:linear-gradient(145deg,var(--primary-dark) 0%,var(--primary) 100%);
    color:#fdfcf8;padding:11px 14px 10px;position:sticky;top:0;z-index:90;
    box-shadow:0 2px 12px rgba(42,77,57,.20),0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.05) inset}
    .top-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px}
    .top h1{font-size:1.02rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.5px;line-height:1.2;
    display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
    .top h1 .logo-mark{flex-shrink:0;display:inline-block;width:24px;height:24px;
    filter:drop-shadow(0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.15))}
    .top h1 .logo-mark svg{display:block;width:100%;height:100%}
    .top p{display:none} /* subtitle hidden — stats row shows the same info */
    .updated{font-size:0.66rem;background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);padding:2px 8px;
    border-radius:99px;white-space:nowrap;align-self:center;font-weight:600;
    letter-spacing:.4px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
    /* STATS — compact horizontal row */
    .stats{display:flex;margin-top:8px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);padding-top:7px;gap:0}
    .s{flex:1;text-align:center;border-right:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.10);padding:0 4px;min-width:0}
    .s:last-child{border-right:none}
    .s b{display:block;font-size:1.15rem;font-weight:800;color:#e8d28f;line-height:1.05;
    font-style:normal;white-space:nowrap;letter-spacing:0;
    font-feature-settings:"tnum"}
    .s b i{font-style:normal;font-size:.72rem;font-weight:600;opacity:.65;letter-spacing:-.3px;color:#d8c89a}
    .s span{font-size:0.62rem;opacity:.7;margin-top:2px;display:block;white-space:nowrap;
    font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.4px}
    /* PROGRESS — slimmer bar, compact label */
    .prog{margin-top:7px}
    .prog-bar{height:5px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);border-radius:99px;overflow:hidden}
    .prog-fill{height:100%;border-radius:99px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#e8d28f,#c98a2b);
    transition:width .6s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1);
    box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(232,210,143,.3)}
    .prog-lbl{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin-top:3px;
    font-size:0.62rem;opacity:.6;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.2px}
    /* ── TABS — pill-shaped, soft borders ── */
    .tab-wrap{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:80;background:var(--bg);
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
    .tabs{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;padding:6px 0;
    scrollbar-width:none}
    .tabs::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
    /* Each row scrolls horizontally on its own */
    .filter-row{display:flex;gap:6px;padding:0 12px;overflow-x:auto;
    scrollbar-width:none}
    .filter-row::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
    .filter-tags{padding-bottom:1px}
    .tab{flex-shrink:0;padding:4px 11px;border-radius:99px;
    border:1.5px solid var(--border);background:var(--surf);
    font-size:.72rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;
    color:var(--muted);transition:.15s;letter-spacing:.3px;
    font-family:inherit}
    .tab:active{background:var(--surf-2)}
    .tab.on{background:var(--primary);color:#fdfcf8;border-color:var(--primary);
    box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(61,107,79,.25)}
    /* Tag tabs use a distinct "selected" color so they're visually separate from the status row */
    .tag-tab.on{background:var(--earth);color:#fdfcf8;border-color:var(--earth);
    box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(139,111,71,.25)}
    /* ── MONTHLY STATS STRIP ── */
    .mstats-wrap{background:var(--surf);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);padding:7px 0 8px;
    transition:padding .2s}
    .mstats-wrap.collapsed{padding:5px 0}
    .mstats-wrap.collapsed .mstats-strip{display:none}
    .mstats-wrap.collapsed .mstats-head{padding-bottom:0}
    .mstats-arrow{display:inline-block;font-size:.7em;transition:transform .2s;margin-left:3px;opacity:.6}
    .mstats-wrap:not(.collapsed) .mstats-arrow{transform:rotate(90deg)}
    .mstats-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;
    padding:0 12px 5px;font-size:0.7rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);
    letter-spacing:.4px;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
    .mstats-head:active{opacity:.7}
    .mstats-head .mstats-summary{font-size:0.70rem;color:var(--faint);font-weight:600}
    .mstats-strip{display:flex;overflow-x:auto;gap:5px;padding:0 10px 2px;
    scrollbar-width:none;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
    .mstats-strip::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
    .mstat{flex-shrink:0;width:64px;border-radius:10px;padding:6px 4px 7px;
    text-align:center;background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--border);position:relative;
    cursor:pointer;transition:transform .12s ease,box-shadow .12s ease;
    -webkit-user-select:none;user-select:none}
    .mstat:active{transform:scale(.94)}
    .mstat.past{background:#f0fdf4;border-color:#bbf7d0}
    .mstat.curr{background:#fffbeb;border-color:#fde68a;
    box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(240,180,41,.25)}
    .mstat.fut{background:var(--surf);border-color:var(--border)}
    .mstat.empty{opacity:.5}
    /* Selected (acts as a month filter) — overrides past/curr/fut visuals */
    .mstat.selected{background:var(--primary)!important;border-color:var(--primary-dark)!important;
    box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--primary-dark),0 4px 10px rgba(61,107,79,.35)!important;
    opacity:1!important}
    .mstat.selected .mlabel,.mstat.selected .myear,
    .mstat.selected .mpeaks,.mstat.selected .msub{color:#fdfcf8!important}
    .mstat .mlabel{font-size:0.70rem;font-weight:800;color:var(--txt);line-height:1.1}
    .mstat .myear{font-size:0.66rem;color:var(--muted);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.3px;margin-top:1px}
    .mstat.past .myear{color:#15803d}
    .mstat.curr .myear{color:#a16207}
    .mstat .mpeaks{font-size:1.05rem;font-weight:900;color:var(--txt);line-height:1.1;margin:3px 0 1px}
    .mstat.past .mpeaks{color:#15803d}
    .mstat.curr .mpeaks{color:#a16207}
    .mstat .msub{font-size:0.66rem;color:var(--faint);font-weight:600;line-height:1.2}
    .mstat.past .msub{color:#16a34a}
    .mstat.curr .msub{color:#ca8a04}
    .mstat .mhikes{font-size:0.66rem;color:var(--faint);font-weight:600}
    /* Year boundary marker — shows BEFORE the first cell of each new year */
    .mstat.year-start{margin-left:8px;position:relative}
    .mstat.year-start::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:-5px;top:6px;bottom:6px;
    width:2px;background:var(--gold);border-radius:1px;opacity:.6}
    /* ── SEARCH BAR ── */
    .search-wrap{padding:11px 12px 5px;background:var(--bg)}
    .search-box{display:flex;align-items:center;background:var(--surf);
    border:1.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:99px;padding:0 10px 0 13px;
    transition:.15s;box-shadow:var(--sh)}
    .search-box:focus-within{border-color:var(--primary);
    box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--primary-tint),var(--sh)}
    .search-icon{font-size:.9rem;flex-shrink:0;opacity:.55}
    .search-box input{flex:1;border:none;outline:none;background:none;
    font-family:inherit;font-size:.85rem;padding:10px 8px;color:var(--txt);min-width:0;
    letter-spacing:.02em}
    .search-box input::placeholder{color:var(--faint);letter-spacing:.02em}
    .search-clear{background:none;border:none;font-size:.85rem;color:var(--muted);
    cursor:pointer;padding:6px 4px;line-height:1}
    .search-clear:active{color:var(--txt)}
    .search-result{font-size:.68rem;color:var(--muted);padding:5px 8px 0;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.2px}
    .search-result b{color:var(--primary)}
    /* Card highlight when matched */
    .card.search-hit{outline:2px solid var(--gold);outline-offset:1px}
    /* ── PAGE ── */
    .page{display:none;padding-bottom:70px}.page.on{display:block}
    /* ── SECTION LABEL ── */
    .slbl{padding:14px 14px 5px;font-size:.66rem;font-weight:700;
    color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.8px;text-transform:uppercase}
    /* ── CARD LIST ── */
    .cl{padding:0 11px 9px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
    /* ── CARD — gentle earth tones, more breathing room ── */
    .card{border-radius:var(--r);padding:14px 14px 12px;box-shadow:var(--sh);
    border:1px solid var(--border);position:relative;overflow:hidden;
    background:var(--surf);transition:box-shadow .15s,transform .12s}
    .card:active{transform:scale(.998);box-shadow:var(--sh-md)}
    .card::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;
    width:4px;border-radius:var(--r) 0 0 var(--r)}
    .card.done {background:#f4f8f0}.card.done::before {background:var(--primary)}
    .card.part {background:#faf5e8}.card.part::before {background:var(--amber)}
    .card.sp {background:#f4f8f0}.card.sp::before {background:var(--moss)}
    .card.sm {background:#fbf2ef}.card.sm::before {background:var(--clay)}
    .card.au {background:#faf3e8}.card.au::before {background:var(--earth)}
    /* NEXT hike highlight — softer ring, no harsh outline */
    .card.next{border:1.5px solid var(--primary);
    box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--primary-tint),var(--sh-md)}
    .next-badge{position:absolute;top:0;right:0;font-size:0.66rem;font-weight:700;
    padding:4px 11px 4px 13px;border-radius:0 var(--r) 0 12px;
    background:var(--primary);color:#fdfcf8;letter-spacing:.5px}
    /* CHIP — softer corners, earth-tinted */
    .chip{position:absolute;top:11px;right:11px;font-size:0.66rem;font-weight:700;
    padding:3px 9px;border-radius:99px;color:#fdfcf8;letter-spacing:.4px;
    box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.08)}
    .done-c{background:var(--primary)}
    .part-c{background:var(--amber)}
    .warn-c{background:var(--clay)}
    /* CARD BODY — improved Chinese readability */
    .cdate{font-size:.66rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:3px;letter-spacing:.3px}
    .cpeaks{font-size:1.06rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--txt);
    line-height:1.45;margin:3px 0 9px;padding-right:70px;letter-spacing:.02em}
    .tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:5px;margin-bottom:7px}
    .tag{font-size:0.72rem;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:99px;
    font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap;border:1px solid transparent;letter-spacing:.2px}
    .t-a{background:var(--surf-2);color:var(--muted)}
    .t-m{background:var(--surf-2);color:var(--muted)}
    /* Difficulty tags — natural mineral palette */
    .t-1{background:#e8f0f5;color:#3a5d75;border-color:#c8d8e3} /* mist blue */
    .t-2{background:#eaf2e6;color:#3d6b4f;border-color:#c8dac0} /* leaf green */
    .t-3{background:#f5ecd8;color:#7a5a1f;border-color:#e3d4ad} /* sand */
    .t-4{background:#f5e2cf;color:#8b4f25;border-color:#e3c4a3} /* clay */
    .t-5{background:#f0d8d2;color:#8c3a30;border-color:#dba99e} /* terracotta */
    .t-boat{background:#e8eef5;color:#3a5d75;border-color:#cbd8e3}
    .t-warn{background:#f0d8d2;color:#8c3a30;border-color:#dba99e}
    .t-fix{background:#f5ecd8;color:#7a5a1f;border-color:#e3d4ad}
    .t-new{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--primary),var(--primary-dark));color:#fdfcf8;border-color:transparent}
    /* Per-peak difficulty tag */
    .tag-pd{font-size:0.70rem;padding:2px 7px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.3px}
    .tag-pd::before{content:"";display:inline-block;width:3px;height:3px;
    border-radius:50%;background:currentColor;opacity:.4;margin-right:5px;vertical-align:middle}
    .ctr{font-size:.66rem;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.7;margin-bottom:4px;letter-spacing:.2px}
    .done-lbl{font-size:.7rem;font-weight:700;margin-top:4px;letter-spacing:.2px}
    .dl-ok{color:var(--primary)}.dl-p{color:var(--amber)}
    .day-n{position:absolute;bottom:9px;right:11px;font-size:0.66rem;
    font-weight:700;color:var(--faint);letter-spacing:.3px}
    /* ROUTE */
    .rtog{font-size:.68rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--teal);cursor:pointer;
    padding:6px 0 1px;border-top:1px solid var(--border);margin-top:6px;
    user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none}
    .rbody{display:none;margin-top:8px}
    .rbody.open{display:block}
    .wps{margin-bottom:7px}
    .wp{display:flex;gap:7px;position:relative}
    .wp:not(:last-child)::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:5px;
    top:15px;bottom:-4px;width:2px;background:var(--border)}
    .wd{width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;flex-shrink:0;margin-top:3px;
    border:2px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 0 0 1.5px currentColor}
    .wg{color:var(--green);background:var(--green)}
    .wb2{color:#3b82f6;background:#3b82f6}
    .wo{color:var(--amber);background:var(--amber)}
    .wr{color:var(--red);background:var(--red)}
    .wx{color:var(--faint);background:var(--faint)}
    .wbody{flex:1;padding-bottom:9px}
    .wbody b{font-size:.74rem;font-weight:700;color:#1a1612}
    .wn{font-size:0.72rem;color:var(--muted);display:block;margin-top:1px}
    .rtip{font-size:.68rem;line-height:1.65;padding:7px 9px;border-radius:9px;margin-top:4px}
    .ri{background:#eff6ff;color:#1e40af}
    .rw{background:#fee2e2;color:#991b1b}
    .rb{background:#eff6ff;color:#1d4ed8}
    .ro{background:#fffbeb;color:#92400e}
    /* ── AREA ── */
    .agrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:9px;padding:10px 12px}
    .ac{border-radius:var(--r-sm);padding:11px 12px;box-shadow:var(--sh);
    border:1px solid var(--border-strong);transition:box-shadow .15s}
    .ac:active{box-shadow:var(--sh-md)}
    .acn{font-size:.78rem;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:6px;color:var(--txt);
    letter-spacing:.3px;line-height:1.3}
    .acc{font-size:0.70rem;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.5px;
    background:rgba(255,255,255,.55);padding:1px 7px;border-radius:99px;
    display:inline-block;margin-left:3px}
    .pd{font-size:.66rem;color:#2d7a4d;font-weight:700;line-height:1.85;opacity:.78}
    .pp{font-size:.66rem;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.85}
    /* Tappable peak chips on region grid */
    .p-tap{cursor:pointer;border-radius:4px;padding:0 4px;margin:0 -4px;transition:background .15s}
    .p-tap:active{background:rgba(56,52,42,.06)}
    /* Edit override indicator */
    .hl-edit-dot{display:inline-block;width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;
    background:var(--earth);margin-left:6px;vertical-align:middle;opacity:.7}
    /* ── TIPS ── */
    .tw{padding:10px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px;padding-bottom:70px}
    .tc{border-radius:var(--r);padding:13px;box-shadow:var(--sh);border:1px solid var(--border)}
    .tc-t{font-size:.87rem;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:7px}
    .tc-b{font-size:.74rem;line-height:1.85;color:var(--muted)}
    .tc-b b{color:var(--txt)}
    /* ── BNAV — softer with subtle pill on active ── */
    .bnav{position:fixed;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;background:rgba(255,255,255,.94);
    backdrop-filter:saturate(180%) blur(10px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:saturate(180%) blur(10px);
    border-top:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;justify-content:space-around;
    padding:8px 0 max(9px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
    box-shadow:0 -2px 14px rgba(56,52,42,.06);z-index:95}
    .nb{text-align:center;font-size:0.70rem;font-weight:500;color:var(--faint);
    cursor:pointer;padding:2px 14px;letter-spacing:.3px;transition:color .15s;
    position:relative}
    .nb .ic{font-size:1.1rem;display:block;margin-bottom:2px;transition:transform .2s}
    .nb:active .ic{transform:scale(.92)}
    .nb.on{color:var(--primary);font-weight:700}
    .nb.on .ic{transform:scale(1.05)}
    /* ── WEATHER ── */
    .wx-loading{text-align:center;padding:40px 16px;color:var(--muted);font-size:.82rem}
    .wx-loading .spinner{display:inline-block;width:20px;height:20px;border:2.5px solid var(--border);
    border-top-color:var(--teal);border-radius:50%;animation:spin .7s linear infinite;margin-bottom:8px}
    @keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
    .wx-err{text-align:center;padding:30px 16px;color:var(--red);font-size:.78rem}
    .wx-retry{margin-top:10px;padding:6px 16px;border:1.5px solid var(--red);border-radius:99px;
    background:none;color:var(--red);font-size:.72rem;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer}
    /* Warning banner */
    .wx-warn-banner{margin:10px;padding:11px 12px;border-radius:11px;
    background:#fee2e2;border:1.5px solid #fca5a5;display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:flex-start}
    .wx-warn-banner .wx-wi{font-size:1.2rem;flex-shrink:0}
    .wx-warn-banner .wx-wb{font-size:.72rem;color:#991b1b;font-weight:600;line-height:1.6}
    .wx-warn-banner.clear{background:#f0fdf4;border-color:#bbf7d0}
    .wx-warn-banner.clear .wx-wb{color:#166534}
    /* Forecast strip */
    .wx-strip{display:flex;overflow-x:auto;gap:6px;padding:10px 10px 4px;scrollbar-width:none}
    .wx-strip::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
    .wx-day{flex-shrink:0;width:72px;border-radius:11px;padding:8px 6px;text-align:center;
    background:var(--surf);border:1px solid var(--border);box-shadow:var(--sh);position:relative}
    .wx-day.hike-day{border:2px solid var(--teal);background:rgba(1,105,111,.04)}
    .wx-day.today{border:2px solid var(--gold)}
    .wx-day .wd-date{font-size:0.70rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted)}
    .wx-day .wd-icon{font-size:1.4rem;margin:4px 0 2px;display:block}
    .wx-day .wd-temp{font-size:0.72rem;color:var(--txt);font-weight:700;font-feature-settings:"tnum"}
    .wx-day .wd-psr{font-size:0.70rem;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:99px;margin-top:4px;
    display:inline-flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:1px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.15}
    .wx-day .wd-psr small{font-size:0.66rem;font-weight:600;opacity:.85;font-feature-settings:"tnum";letter-spacing:0}
    .psr-low{background:#e6efe1;color:#3d6b4f}
    .psr-medlow{background:#eaf2e6;color:#3d6b4f}
    .psr-med{background:#f5ecd8;color:#7a5a1f}
    .psr-medhigh{background:#f5e2cf;color:#8b4f25}
    .psr-high{background:#f0d8d2;color:#8c3a30}
    .wx-day .hike-dot{position:absolute;top:4px;right:4px;width:7px;height:7px;
    border-radius:50%;background:var(--primary)}
    /* Advisory cards */
    .wx-adv-list{padding:0 10px 8px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
    .wx-adv{border-radius:var(--r);padding:12px;box-shadow:var(--sh);
    border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--surf);position:relative}
    .wx-adv .adv-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:6px}
    .wx-adv .adv-peaks{font-size:.88rem;font-weight:800;color:#1a1612}
    .wx-adv .adv-date{font-size:0.72rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted)}
    .wx-adv .adv-verdict{padding:5px 10px;border-radius:8px;font-size:.72rem;
    font-weight:800;text-align:center;margin:6px 0;letter-spacing:.3px}
    .verdict-go{background:#dcfce7;color:#166534;border:1px solid #bbf7d0}
    .verdict-caution{background:#fef3c7;color:#92400e;border:1px solid #fde68a}
    .verdict-postpone{background:#fee2e2;color:#991b1b;border:1px solid #fca5a5}
    .verdict-nodata{background:rgba(40,37,29,.05);color:var(--muted);border:1px solid var(--border)}
    .wx-adv .adv-detail{font-size:.68rem;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.7}
    .wx-adv .adv-detail b{color:var(--txt)}
    .wx-adv .adv-reasons{margin-top:6px;font-size:.66rem;line-height:1.7}
    .adv-reason{padding:2px 8px;border-radius:6px;margin:2px 0;display:inline-block}
    .ar-ok{background:#f0fdf4;color:#166534}.ar-warn{background:#fff7ed;color:#9a3412}
    .ar-bad{background:#fef2f2;color:#991b1b}
    /* Weather badge on schedule cards */
    .wx-badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:3px;font-size:0.66rem;font-weight:700;
    padding:2px 7px;border-radius:99px;margin-left:4px;vertical-align:middle}
    .wxb-go{background:#dcfce7;color:#166534}
    .wxb-caution{background:#fef3c7;color:#92400e}
    .wxb-postpone{background:#fee2e2;color:#991b1b}
    /* Seasonal guidance */
    .wx-seasonal{margin:10px;padding:12px;border-radius:var(--r);background:var(--surf);
    box-shadow:var(--sh);border:1px solid var(--border)}
    .wx-seasonal .ws-t{font-size:.78rem;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:6px}
    .wx-seasonal .ws-b{font-size:.68rem;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.7}
    /* ── EDIT BUTTON ── */
    .edit-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:3px;font-size:.66rem;font-weight:700;
    color:var(--teal);cursor:pointer;padding:6px 10px;border-radius:8px;
    background:rgba(1,105,111,.08);border:1px solid rgba(1,105,111,.2);
    margin-top:6px;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none}
    .edit-btn:active{background:rgba(1,105,111,.18)}
    .edit-btn-row{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-top:6px;flex-wrap:wrap}
    .local-badge{display:inline-block;font-size:0.66rem;font-weight:700;color:#7c3aed;
    background:#f3e8ff;border:1px solid #d8b4fe;padding:1px 6px;border-radius:99px;
    margin-left:4px;vertical-align:middle}
    /* ── EDIT MODAL ── */
    .em-overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.55);z-index:200;
    display:none;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(2px);backdrop-filter:blur(2px)}
    .em-overlay.on{display:flex}
    .em-box{background:var(--surf);width:100%;max-width:480px;
    border-radius:18px 18px 0 0;padding:18px 16px max(18px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
    box-shadow:0 -10px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.2);max-height:90dvh;overflow-y:auto;
    animation:slideUp .25s cubic-bezier(.34,1.4,.64,1)}
    @keyframes slideUp{from{transform:translateY(100%)}to{transform:translateY(0)}}
    .em-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;
    margin-bottom:14px;padding-bottom:11px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
    .em-head h3{font-size:.95rem;font-weight:800;line-height:1.35}
    .em-head .em-sub{font-size:.65rem;color:var(--muted);margin-top:2px;font-weight:500}
    .em-close{font-size:1.5rem;color:var(--faint);cursor:pointer;line-height:1;
    padding:0 4px;background:none;border:none}
    .em-row{margin-bottom:13px}
    .em-row label{display:block;font-size:.68rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);
    margin-bottom:5px;letter-spacing:.3px}
    .status-pick{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:6px}
    .status-pick button{padding:9px 4px;border-radius:9px;border:1.5px solid var(--border);
    background:var(--surf);font-size:.7rem;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;
    font-family:inherit;color:var(--txt);transition:.15s}
    .status-pick button.on{border-color:var(--teal);background:rgba(1,105,111,.08);
    color:var(--teal);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(1,105,111,.15)}
    .em-row input[type=date],.em-row input[type=number],.em-row textarea{
    width:100%;padding:9px 11px;border:1.5px solid var(--border);
    border-radius:9px;font-size:.78rem;font-family:inherit;
    background:var(--bg);color:var(--txt);outline:none;transition:.15s}
    .em-row input:focus,.em-row textarea:focus{border-color:var(--teal);
    background:var(--surf)}
    .em-row textarea{resize:vertical;min-height:54px}
    .em-foot{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:18px}
    .em-foot button{flex:1;padding:11px;border-radius:10px;border:none;
    font-size:.8rem;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit}
    .em-cancel{background:var(--bg);color:var(--muted);border:1.5px solid var(--border)!important}
    .em-save{background:var(--teal);color:#fff}
    .em-save:active{background:#015257}
    .em-info{font-size:0.70rem;color:var(--faint);background:#f9f9f7;
    padding:8px 10px;border-radius:8px;line-height:1.55;margin-top:4px}
    .peak-counter{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
    .peak-counter input{flex:1}
    .peak-total{font-size:.7rem;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap}
    /* Edit modal — collapsible details section */
    .em-details-tog{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;
    padding:11px 12px;border-radius:10px;background:#f9f9f7;border:1.5px dashed var(--border);
    cursor:pointer;font-size:.74rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--teal);user-select:none;
    -webkit-user-select:none;margin-bottom:13px}
    .em-details-tog:active{background:#f0efea}
    .em-details-tog .arr{transition:transform .2s;font-size:.85rem}
    .em-details-tog.open .arr{transform:rotate(90deg)}
    .em-details-body{display:none;padding:11px;border:1.5px solid var(--border);
    border-radius:10px;margin-bottom:13px;background:#fafaf7}
    .em-details-body.open{display:block}
    .em-grid2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px}
    .em-grid2 .em-row{margin-bottom:0}
    .em-flag-row{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:4px}
    .em-flag{flex:1;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:8px 10px;
    border:1.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:9px;background:var(--surf);
    cursor:pointer;font-size:.72rem;font-weight:700;user-select:none;
    -webkit-user-select:none;transition:.15s}
    .em-flag input{accent-color:var(--teal);cursor:pointer;width:16px;height:16px}
    .em-flag.on{border-color:var(--teal);background:rgba(1,105,111,.08);color:var(--teal)}
    .em-diff-pick{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr);gap:4px}
    .em-diff-pick button{padding:8px 0;border-radius:7px;border:1.5px solid var(--border);
    background:var(--surf);font-size:.72rem;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;
    font-family:inherit;color:var(--txt)}
    .em-diff-pick button.on{background:var(--teal);color:#fff;border-color:var(--teal)}
    .em-revert{font-size:.65rem;color:var(--red);font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;
    text-decoration:underline;margin-top:6px;display:inline-block}
    /* Reset / sync card */
    .tc-reset{background:#fef2f2;border:1px solid #fecaca!important}
    .tc-reset .tc-t{color:#991b1b}
    .tc-reset button{background:var(--red);color:#fff;border:none;padding:9px 14px;
    border-radius:9px;font-weight:700;font-size:.74rem;cursor:pointer;
    font-family:inherit}
    .tc-reset button:active{filter:brightness(.92)}
    .tc-reset .reset-info{font-size:.7rem;color:#7f1d1d;line-height:1.6;
    font-weight:600;padding:6px 9px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.6);
    border-radius:8px;border:1px dashed #fca5a5}
    /* GitHub sync card */
    .tc-gh{background:#0d1117!important;border:1px solid #30363d!important;color:#c9d1d9}
    .tc-gh .tc-t{color:#f0f6fc}
    .tc-gh .tc-b{color:#8b949e}
    .tc-gh .tc-b b{color:#c9d1d9}
    .tc-gh button{background:#238636;color:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(240,246,252,.1);
    padding:9px 14px;border-radius:9px;font-weight:700;font-size:.74rem;cursor:pointer;
    font-family:inherit}
    .tc-gh button.gh-secondary{background:#21262d;color:#c9d1d9;border-color:#30363d}
    .tc-gh button.gh-warn{background:#da3633}
    .tc-gh button:active{filter:brightness(.85)}
    .gh-status{font-size:.65rem;line-height:1.6;padding:8px 10px;background:rgba(240,246,252,.04);
    border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #30363d;margin-bottom:8px;color:#8b949e}
    .gh-status.ok{border-color:#1f6feb;color:#58a6ff}
    .gh-status.warn{border-color:#9e6a03;color:#d29922}
    .gh-status.err{border-color:#da3633;color:#f85149}
    .gh-status code{font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;font-size:.95em;
    background:rgba(110,118,129,.4);padding:1px 4px;border-radius:3px;color:#c9d1d9}
    /* GitHub settings modal — uses em-overlay/em-box styling */
    .gh-help{font-size:.66rem;line-height:1.65;color:var(--muted);
    padding:9px 11px;border-radius:9px;background:#f0f6fc;border:1px solid #d0d7de;margin-bottom:12px}
    .gh-help a{color:#0969da;font-weight:700;text-decoration:none}
    .gh-help b{color:var(--txt)}
    .gh-token-row{position:relative}
    .gh-token-row input{font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;letter-spacing:.5px}
    .gh-token-show{position:absolute;right:6px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);
    background:none;border:none;font-size:.85rem;cursor:pointer;padding:6px;color:var(--muted)}
    /* Auto-sync toggle row in settings modal */
    .gh-auto-row{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
    .gh-auto-toggle{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-size:.74rem;
    font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;padding:9px 11px;background:var(--bg);
    border-radius:9px;border:1.5px solid var(--border);user-select:none;
    -webkit-user-select:none;transition:.15s}
    .gh-auto-toggle input{width:18px;height:18px;accent-color:var(--teal);cursor:pointer;flex-shrink:0}
    .gh-auto-toggle:has(input:checked){border-color:var(--teal);background:rgba(1,105,111,.06)}
    .gh-auto-toggle .gh-auto-desc{font-size:0.70rem;color:var(--muted);font-weight:500;margin-top:2px;line-height:1.4}
    /* Pulse indicator for active sync */
    @keyframes gh-pulse{0%,100%{opacity:.4}50%{opacity:1}}
    .gh-syncing{display:inline-block;animation:gh-pulse 1s ease-in-out infinite}
    /* ── TOAST NOTIFICATIONS ── */
    .toast-stack{position:fixed;left:10px;right:10px;bottom:max(70px,calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom)+70px));
    z-index:300;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;pointer-events:none}
    .toast{background:var(--surf);border-radius:11px;padding:11px 14px;
    box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.18),0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.08);
    font-size:.78rem;font-weight:600;line-height:1.45;color:var(--txt);
    display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:9px;pointer-events:auto;
    border-left:4px solid var(--teal);
    animation:toast-in .25s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1)}
    .toast.out{animation:toast-out .2s ease forwards}
    .toast.t-ok{border-left-color:var(--green);background:#f0fdf4}
    .toast.t-err{border-left-color:var(--red);background:#fef2f2}
    .toast.t-warn{border-left-color:var(--amber);background:#fffbeb}
    .toast.t-info{border-left-color:var(--blue);background:#eff6ff}
    .toast .ti{font-size:1.1rem;flex-shrink:0;line-height:1}
    .toast .tb{flex:1;min-width:0;word-wrap:break-word}
    .toast .tx{background:none;border:none;font-size:1rem;color:var(--faint);
    cursor:pointer;padding:0 2px;line-height:1;flex-shrink:0;align-self:flex-start;margin-top:1px}
    @keyframes toast-in{from{transform:translateY(20px);opacity:0}to{transform:translateY(0);opacity:1}}
    @keyframes toast-out{to{transform:translateY(20px);opacity:0}}
    /* ── UPCOMING HIKE BANNER ── */
    .upcoming{margin:11px 12px 0;border-radius:var(--r);padding:13px 14px;
    background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--primary-dark),var(--primary));color:#fdfcf8;
    box-shadow:var(--sh-md);cursor:pointer;
    display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
    transition:transform .12s,box-shadow .12s;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
    .upcoming:active{transform:scale(.99);box-shadow:var(--sh)}
    .upcoming.urgent{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#8b3a30,var(--clay))}
    .upcoming.today{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#8b6f47,var(--earth));
    animation:upcoming-pulse 2.4s ease-in-out infinite}
    @keyframes upcoming-pulse{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(139,111,71,.35)}
    50%{box-shadow:0 4px 22px rgba(139,111,71,.55)}}
    .upcoming .uc-days{flex-shrink:0;text-align:center;min-width:54px;padding-right:12px;
    border-right:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.20);line-height:1}
    .upcoming .uc-num{font-size:1.55rem;font-weight:800;color:#e8d28f;display:block;
    font-feature-settings:"tnum"}
    .upcoming.today .uc-num,.upcoming.urgent .uc-num{color:#fdfcf8}
    .upcoming .uc-unit{font-size:0.66rem;font-weight:700;opacity:.7;letter-spacing:.6px;
    text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:4px;display:block}
    .upcoming .uc-body{flex:1;min-width:0}
    .upcoming .uc-date{font-size:.66rem;font-weight:600;opacity:.78;letter-spacing:.4px}
    .upcoming .uc-peaks{font-size:.96rem;font-weight:700;line-height:1.35;margin-top:3px;
    white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;letter-spacing:.02em}
    .upcoming .uc-meta{font-size:0.72rem;opacity:.78;margin-top:4px;display:flex;
    flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;align-items:center}
    .upcoming .uc-meta .uc-wx{padding:2px 8px;border-radius:99px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);
    font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.2px}
    .upcoming .uc-arrow{flex-shrink:0;font-size:1.2rem;opacity:.55;align-self:center}
    /* ── PULL-TO-REFRESH ── */.ptr-indicator{position:fixed;top:0;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(-50px);
    z-index:88;background:var(--surf);border:1.5px solid var(--border);
    border-radius:99px;padding:8px 14px;font-size:.74rem;font-weight:700;
    color:var(--teal);box-shadow:var(--sh);
    display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;
    transition:transform .15s ease,opacity .15s ease;opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
    .ptr-indicator.show{opacity:1}
    .ptr-indicator .ptr-arrow{display:inline-block;font-size:.95rem;
    transition:transform .2s}
    .ptr-indicator.ready .ptr-arrow{transform:rotate(180deg)}
    .ptr-indicator.refreshing .ptr-arrow{animation:gh-pulse 1s linear infinite}
    /* ── DIFFICULTY STATS PANEL ── */
    .diffstats-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:10px 12px;
    border-radius:var(--r-sm);background:var(--surf);border:1px solid var(--border);
    margin-bottom:7px;box-shadow:var(--sh)}
    .diffstats-row .ds-stars{font-size:.84rem;letter-spacing:.6px;font-weight:700;
    color:var(--earth);flex-shrink:0;min-width:80px}
    .diffstats-row .ds-bar{flex:1;height:8px;background:var(--surf-2);border-radius:99px;overflow:hidden}
    .diffstats-row .ds-fill{height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--primary-soft),var(--primary));
    border-radius:99px;transition:width .4s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1)}
    .diffstats-row .ds-fill.zero{background:var(--border)}
    .diffstats-row .ds-num{flex-shrink:0;font-size:.82rem;font-weight:800;min-width:64px;text-align:right;
    color:var(--txt);font-feature-settings:"tnum"}
    .diffstats-row .ds-num small{font-size:0.70rem;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600}
    .diffstats-row .ds-pct{flex-shrink:0;font-size:0.72rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);
    min-width:38px;text-align:right;font-feature-settings:"tnum"}
    .diffstats-row .ds-share{flex-shrink:0;font-size:0.70rem;font-weight:600;
    color:var(--faint);min-width:46px;text-align:right;font-feature-settings:"tnum";
    padding-left:7px;border-left:1px solid var(--border)}
    /* ── VIEW TABS (pill buttons) — used on 統計 page ── */
    .view-tabs{display:flex;gap:7px;padding:12px 12px 5px;background:var(--bg)}
    .vt-btn{flex:1;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:99px;border:1.5px solid var(--border);
    background:var(--surf);color:var(--muted);font-size:.78rem;font-weight:600;
    font-family:inherit;cursor:pointer;transition:.15s;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;letter-spacing:.4px}
    .vt-btn.on{background:var(--primary);color:#fdfcf8;border-color:var(--primary);
    box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(61,107,79,.25)}
    .vt-btn:not(.on):active{background:var(--surf-2)}
    /* ── HEIGHT LIST CONTROLS ── */
    .height-controls{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px;padding:8px 12px 10px;align-items:center}
    .hc-btn{padding:6px 13px;border-radius:99px;border:1.5px solid var(--border);
    background:var(--surf);color:var(--muted);font-size:.7rem;font-weight:600;
    font-family:inherit;cursor:pointer;transition:.15s;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;letter-spacing:.3px}
    .hc-btn.on{background:var(--earth);color:#fdfcf8;border-color:var(--earth)}
    #height-search{flex:1;min-width:140px;padding:7px 14px;border-radius:99px;
    border:1.5px solid var(--border);background:var(--surf);color:var(--txt);
    font-family:inherit;font-size:.76rem;outline:none;letter-spacing:.02em}
    #height-search:focus{border-color:var(--primary);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--primary-tint)}
    /* ── HEIGHT LIST ROWS ── */
    .hl-stats{padding:0 14px 7px;font-size:0.72rem;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.3px}
    .hl-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;padding:10px 14px;
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--surf);
    transition:background .12s}
    .hl-row:active{background:var(--surf-2)}
    .hl-rank{flex-shrink:0;font-size:0.70rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--faint);
    min-width:30px;text-align:right;font-feature-settings:"tnum";letter-spacing:.3px}
    .hl-status{flex-shrink:0;font-size:.9rem;line-height:1;width:20px;text-align:center}
    .hl-info{flex:1;min-width:0}
    .hl-name{font-size:.92rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--txt);
    white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;letter-spacing:.02em}
    .hl-name.done{color:var(--muted);opacity:.72}
    .hl-meta{font-size:0.70rem;color:var(--faint);margin-top:2px;
    white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;letter-spacing:.2px}
    .hl-height{flex-shrink:0;text-align:right;min-width:65px}
    .hl-height-num{font-size:1.05rem;font-weight:800;color:var(--earth);line-height:1;
    font-feature-settings:"tnum"}
    .hl-height-unit{font-size:0.66rem;color:var(--faint);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.6px;margin-top:2px}
    .hl-diff{flex-shrink:0;font-size:0.66rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--earth);letter-spacing:.6px;
    min-width:48px;text-align:right}
    .hl-empty{text-align:center;padding:50px 20px;color:var(--faint);font-size:.85rem}
    /* ── HIKE JOURNAL ── */
    .journal-row{display:none;margin-top:6px;padding:9px 11px;border-radius:9px;
    background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fffbeb 0%,#fef9c3 100%);
    border:1px solid #fde68a;font-size:.7rem;line-height:1.6;color:#78350f}
    .journal-row.show{display:block}
    .journal-row .jh{font-size:0.70rem;font-weight:700;color:#92400e;margin-bottom:3px;
    letter-spacing:.4px;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.8}
    .journal-row .jb{white-space:pre-wrap;word-wrap:break-word}
    /* ── BULK RESCHEDULE MODAL ── */
    .br-list{max-height:38dvh;overflow-y:auto;border:1.5px solid var(--border);
    border-radius:10px;padding:4px;background:var(--bg)}
    .br-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:8px 10px;
    border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;font-size:.74rem;transition:.1s}
    .br-item:hover{background:rgba(1,105,111,.06)}
    .br-item.on{background:rgba(1,105,111,.12)}
    .br-item input{width:18px;height:18px;accent-color:var(--teal);cursor:pointer;flex-shrink:0}
    .br-item-body{flex:1;min-width:0;line-height:1.35}
    .br-item-day{font-weight:700;color:var(--txt);font-size:.72rem}
    .br-item-date{font-size:.66rem;color:var(--muted);margin-top:1px}
    .br-item-peaks{font-size:.68rem;color:var(--txt);margin-top:1px;
    white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
    .br-item-new{font-size:.66rem;color:var(--teal);font-weight:700;margin-top:2px}
    .br-shift{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr);gap:4px;margin-top:6px}
    .br-shift button{padding:7px 0;font-size:.7rem;font-weight:700;border-radius:7px;
    border:1.5px solid var(--border);background:var(--surf);cursor:pointer;
    font-family:inherit;color:var(--txt)}
    .br-shift button:active{background:var(--bg)}
    .br-shift button.on{background:var(--teal);color:#fff;border-color:var(--teal)}
    .br-shift-input{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;margin-top:8px}
    .br-shift-input input{flex:1;text-align:center;font-weight:700;font-size:1rem}
    .br-summary{font-size:.7rem;color:var(--muted);padding:8px 10px;background:var(--bg);
    border-radius:8px;margin-top:8px;line-height:1.55}
    .br-summary b{color:var(--teal)}
    .br-toolbar{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;
    margin-bottom:6px;font-size:.66rem;color:var(--muted)}
    .br-toolbar a{color:var(--teal);cursor:pointer;font-weight:700;text-decoration:none}
    </style>
    </head>

    <div><h1><span class="logo-mark"><svg viewBox="0 0 32 32" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" aria-hidden="true"><defs><clipPath id="hlc"><circle cx="16" cy="16" r="15"/></clipPath></defs><circle cx="16" cy="16" r="15" fill="#fdfcf8"/><g clip-path="url(#hlc)"><rect width="32" height="32" fill="#f4ecd8"/><circle cx="22" cy="11" r="3.2" fill="#c98a2b" opacity="0.85"/><path d="M-2 22 L8 10 L18 22 Z" fill="#a8c5b3"/><path d="M5 24 L13 13 L21 24 Z" fill="#7d8b3a"/><path d="M11 26 L19 12 L27 26 Z" fill="#3d6b4f"/><path d="M17 16 L19 12 L21 16 L20 17 L19 16 L18 17 Z" fill="#fdfcf8" opacity="0.9"/><rect y="25" width="32" height="7" fill="#2a4d39"/></g><circle cx="16" cy="16" r="15" fill="none" stroke="#2a4d39" stroke-width="0.8" opacity="0.3"/></svg></span>山行者計劃</h1><p><span id="total-peaks">—</span>座山峰挑戰 · 已完成<span id="sub-done">—</span> · 詳細路線</p></div>

    <div id="view-region">
    <div class="slbl" style="padding-top:9px">全部山峰按地區（七大地區）— 包括已完成歷史</div>
    <div class="agrid" id="agrid-all"></div>

    <button class="hc-btn" data-sort="asc" onclick="sortHeightList('asc')">⬆️ 由低至高</button>

    <div class="page" id="pg-t">
    <div class="slbl" style="padding-top:13px">📊 難度進度（共 <span id="ds-total">160</span> 座）</div>
    <div style="padding:0 12px 6px;font-size:.62rem;color:var(--faint);line-height:1.5">
    第一個 % = 該難度等級完成率 · <b>佔X%</b> = 該難度佔總山峰百分比
    </div>
    <div id="diffstats-panel" style="padding:0 12px"></div>
    <div class="tw">
    <div class="tc" style="background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0d1d29,var(--teal));border:none">
    <div class="tc-t" style="color:var(--gold)">🌦 天氣策略</div>
    <div class="tc-b" style="color:rgba(255,255,255,.78)">
    <b style="color:#6ee7b7">🌱 4–5月</b> 15–28°C 適合長程高難度，春霧頻繁<br>
    <b style="color:#fde68a">☀️ 6–9月</b> 28–34°C <b style="color:#fca5a5">清晨5–6時起步</b>，短程/離島優先<br>
    <b style="color:#fcd34d">🍂 10–11月</b> <b style="color:var(--gold)">全年最佳</b>，蝻蛇尖·狗牙嶺最佳時機<br>
    <b style="color:#fca5a5">⛔ 出發前查：一號颱風 / 黃雨 / 紅雨</b>
    </div>
    </div>
    <div class="tc" style="background:#fee2e2">
    <div class="tc-t" style="color:#991b1b">⛔ 雨天絕對禁行</div>
    <div class="tc-b">
    · <b>蝻蛇尖</b>（浮沙碎石，致命事故多發）<br>
    · <b>狗牙嶺</b>（一線生機·閻王壁，2017年墮崖身亡）<br>
    · <b>吊燈籠</b>（新界東北第一險峰，陡峭山脊）<br>
    · <b>花香爐頂</b>（暴露山脊，雨後濕滑）<br>
    · <b>岩頭山+雞公山+雷打石山</b>（麥3段曝露嶺脊）<br>
    · <b>石芽山+水牛山+黃牛山</b>（裸露岩石）<br>
    · <b>紅花嶺·龜頭嶺·羌山+靈會山+牙鷹山</b>
    </div>
    </div>
    <div class="tc" style="background:#eff6ff">
    <div class="tc-t" style="color:#1d4ed8">🚢 離島/需渡船行程</div>
    <div class="tc-b">
    · <b>茅平山(塔門島)</b>：黃石碼頭→塔門，約30分鐘，翠華船務<br>
    · <b>黑山頂(橋咀洲)</b>：西貢碼頭街渡，致電確認：2792 4495<br>
    · <b>菱角山+蘆荻灣山(南丫島)</b>：中環4號碼頭→索罟灣<br>
    · <b>牛湖頂(蒲台島)</b>：每週數班，必須提前查詢
    </div>
    </div>
    <div class="tc" style="background:#f0fdf4">
    <div class="tc-t" style="color:#166534">🎒 必備裝備</div>
    <div class="tc-b">
    · 行山鞋（防滑橡膠底+腳踝支撐）<br>
    · 飲用水：短程1.5L，長程3L，夏季4–5L<br>
    · 行山杖（★★★★以上強烈推薦），手套（高危路線）<br>
    · 急救包、備用充電器、哨子、頭燈<br>
    · 離線地圖：<b>Gaia GPS</b> 或 <b>TrailWatch HK</b><br>
    · 緊急：<b>999</b>｜飛行服務隊 <b>2382-0111</b>
    </div>
    </div>
    <div class="tc tc-gh">
    <div class="tc-t">☁️ GitHub 雲端同步</div>
    <div class="tc-b">
    <div class="gh-status" id="gh-status">尚未設定 GitHub。設定後可將進度儲存到自己的 GitHub repo，跨裝置即時讀取。</div>
    <div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px">
    <button onclick="openGhSettings()" class="gh-secondary">⚙️ 設定</button>
    <button onclick="ghLoad()" id="gh-load-btn" disabled style="opacity:.5">⬇️ 從 GitHub 載入</button>
    <button onclick="ghSync()" id="gh-sync-btn" disabled style="opacity:.5">⬆️ 同步到 GitHub</button>
    </div>
    <div style="font-size:.6rem;color:#8b949e;margin-top:8px;line-height:1.55">
    🔒 個人存取權杖（PAT）只儲存在此瀏覽器，永遠不會傳給 Anthropic 或任何第三方。<br>
    📂 進度以 JSON 寫入您指定的 repo 路徑（預設 <code style="font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;background:rgba(110,118,129,.4);padding:1px 4px;border-radius:3px">hiking-progress.json</code>）。
    </div>
    </div>
    </div>
    <div class="tc tc-reset">
    <div class="tc-t">🔄 跨裝置同步進度</div>
    <div class="tc-b">
    <div class="reset-info" id="reset-info" style="margin-bottom:8px">尚未有本地更新記錄</div>
    本地進度只保存在當前瀏覽器（localStorage），不會自動跨裝置同步。換手機/電腦時需手動：<br>
    ① 裝置 A 點「📤 匯出」取得 JSON<br>
    ② 用電郵 / AirDrop / 雲端傳送到裝置 B<br>
    ③ 裝置 B 點「📥 匯入」即可<br>
    <div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin-top:10px">
    <button onclick="openBulkResch()" style="background:#0c4e54">📅 批量改期</button>
    <button onclick="exportProgress()" style="background:var(--teal)">📤 匯出</button>
    <button onclick="openImport()" style="background:var(--blue)">📥 匯入</button>
    <button onclick="resetUpdates()">🗑️ 重置</button>
    </div>
    <div style="font-size:.62rem;color:#7f1d1d;margin-top:8px;line-height:1.55">
    「重置」會清除瀏覽器中所有本地修改，回復內建進度。
    </div>

    <div class="em-overlay" id="em-overlay" onclick="if(event.target===this)closeEdit()">
    <div class="em-box">
    <div class="em-head">
    <div>
    <h3 id="em-title">編輯行程</h3>
    <div class="em-sub" id="em-sub"></div>
    </div>
    <button class="em-close" onclick="closeEdit()">×</button>
    </div>
    <div class="em-row">
    <label>狀態</label>
    <div class="status-pick" id="em-status">
    <button data-s="pending" onclick="pickStatus('pending')">⏳ 待完成</button>
    <button data-s="done" onclick="pickStatus('done')">✅ 已完成</button>
    </div>
    </div>
    <div class="em-row" id="em-resch-row">
    <label>📅 排期日期 <span style="font-weight:500;color:var(--faint)">(可改至其他日子)</span></label>
    <input type="date" id="em-resch">
    <div class="em-info" id="em-resch-info" style="margin-top:4px;display:none"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="em-row" id="em-date-row">
    <label>完成日期</label>
    <input type="date" id="em-date">
    </div>
    <div class="em-row" id="em-journal-row" style="display:none">
    <label>📓 行山回憶（選填）</label>
    <textarea id="em-journal" placeholder="當日感受、特別景色、同行夥伴…日後可重溫" rows="3"></textarea>
    </div>
    <div class="em-details-tog" id="em-details-tog" onclick="toggleDetails()">
    <span>✏️ 編輯行程詳情（山峰、地區、距離等）</span>
    <span class="arr">▶</span>
    </div>
    <div class="em-details-body" id="em-details-body">
    <div class="em-row">
    <label>山峰名稱</label>
    <textarea id="em-d-peaks" rows="2" placeholder="例：大東山、二東山" style="font-size:.78rem"></textarea>
    </div>
    <div class="em-grid2">
    <div class="em-row">
    <label>峰數</label>
    <input type="number" id="em-d-peakCount" min="1" max="20" step="1">
    </div>
    <div class="em-row">
    <label>距離 (km)</label>
    <input type="number" id="em-d-km" min="0" step="0.5">
    </div>
    </div>
    <div class="em-grid2">
    <div class="em-row">
    <label>所需時間</label>
    <input type="text" id="em-d-time" placeholder="例：3-4h">
    </div>
    <div class="em-row">
    <label>地區</label>
    <input type="text" id="em-d-area" placeholder="例：大嶼山西">
    </div>
    </div>
    <div class="em-row">
    <label>難度</label>
    <div class="em-diff-pick" id="em-d-diff">
    <button data-d="1" onclick="pickDiff(1)">★</button>
    <button data-d="2" onclick="pickDiff(2)">★★</button>
    <button data-d="3" onclick="pickDiff(3)">★★★</button>
    <button data-d="3.5" onclick="pickDiff(3.5)">★★★☆</button>
    <button data-d="4" onclick="pickDiff(4)">★★★★</button>
    <button data-d="5" onclick="pickDiff(5)">★★★★★</button>
    </div>
    </div>
    <div class="em-row">
    <label>起點</label>
    <input type="text" id="em-d-start" placeholder="例：大澳">
    </div>
    <div class="em-row">
    <label>交通</label>
    <input type="text" id="em-d-tr" placeholder="例：11巴士由東涌至大澳">
    </div>
    <div class="em-row">
    <label>標籤</label>
    <div class="em-flag-row">
    <label class="em-flag" id="em-d-boat-lbl">
    <input type="checkbox" id="em-d-boat" onchange="updateFlagUI()">
    <span>🚢 需渡船</span>
    </label>
    <label class="em-flag" id="em-d-warn-lbl">
    <input type="checkbox" id="em-d-warn" onchange="updateFlagUI()">
    <span>⚠️ 雨天禁行</span>
    </label>
    </div>
    </div>
    <span class="em-revert" onclick="revertDetails()">↺ 還原此行程的詳情</span>
    </div>
    <div class="em-info" id="em-info">💾 更新會保存到此瀏覽器的本地儲存（localStorage），下次開啟自動載入。匯出 JSON 可備份所有變更。</div>
    <div class="em-foot">
    <button class="em-cancel" onclick="closeEdit()">取消</button>
    <button class="em-save" onclick="saveEdit()">💾 儲存</button>
    </div>
    </div>
    </div>
    <!-- ═══════════════════ PEAK EDIT MODAL ═══════════════════ -->
    <div class="em-overlay" id="pem-overlay" onclick="if(event.target===this)closePeakEdit()">
    <div class="em-box">
    <div class="em-head">
    <div>
    <h3>⛰️ 編輯山峰資料</h3>
    <div class="em-sub" id="pem-sub">—</div>
    </div>
    <button class="em-close" onclick="closePeakEdit()">×</button>
    </div>
    <div class="em-row">
    <label>山峰名稱</label>
    <input type="text" id="pem-name" placeholder="例：扯旗山">
